## Description

Uses Johansen tests to estimate cointegrating relationships among multiple nonstationary asset prices and trades deviations of the resulting spread/basket.

## Where it may fit

Stable long-run relationships among related securities or futures; strongest when hedge relationships survive rolling out-of-sample tests.

## Vehicles

Market-neutral equity, ETF baskets, commodity spreads, FX baskets.

## Required data

Synchronized price series for multiple assets, formation window, cointegration rank tests, execution prices and borrow data.

## Caveats

Multiple-testing risk is high; relationships can break after index changes, mergers or structural regime shifts.
